title: The Day of the Triffids

vibeProfile.oneLine: Most of the world goes blind, and the plants start to move.

summary: After a dazzling meteor shower blinds almost everyone on Earth, the few who can still see must survive in a collapsing world, menaced not only by the breakdown of society but by the triffids: tall, mobile, carnivorous plants that were being farmed until the lights went out. Wyndham's classic 'cosy catastrophe' is a gripping, thoughtful disaster novel about how quickly civilisation unravels and what kind of people rebuild it, and it has shaped apocalyptic fiction ever since.
whyReadIt: The blueprint for the modern apocalypse novel, complete with walking killer plants. Thoughtful and genuinely gripping.

funFacts.text: Wyndham's gentle-seeming British disaster stories inspired the label 'cosy catastrophe'.
